|                                                                  | **Aspirin**                                                                                                                                                                  | **Paracetamol **                                                                                                                                                                     |

| **Use**                                                          | anti-inflammatory, antiplatelet, analgesic                                                                                                                                   | analgesia, antipyretic                                                                                                                                                               |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Dosage**                                                       | 100-1000mg /day                                                                                                                                                              | 15mg/kg to max 1gram 6hourly                                                                                                                                                         |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Toxic dose**                                                   | \>150mg/kg                                                                                                                                                                   | Single ingestion:                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              | Adult \>200mg/kg / or \>10g                                                                                                                                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Toxic Mechanism **                                             | Salicylate is the active metabolite                                                                                                                                          | Primary toxic insult cause is acute liver injury.                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  | 1.  stimulates respiration →respiratory alkalosis                                                                                                                            | Paracetamol is primarily conjugated to inactive metabolites, with a small quantity metabolised by CYP450 → toxic NAPQI, which is usually conjugated by glutathione to inactive form. |
|                                                                  | 2.  uncouples electron transport chain → lactic acid metabolic acidosis                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              | In excess/overdose NAPQI accumulates due to glutathione exhaustion → acute liver toxicity                                                                                            |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Management**                                                   | Specific to aspirin and the situation management to be considered:                                                                                                           | Specific Management:                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| All overdoses should be managed within the toxicology guidelines | - Decontamination with activated charcoal: Activated charcoal absorbs molecules of drug on its surface → inhibiting their absorption by as much as 50% → excretion in faeces | Paracetamol level/LFT                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Resuscitation                                                    | ::: {}                                                                                                                                                                       | → for acute single ingestion overdose level can be plotted on nomogram and treatment decision based on this                                                                          |
|                                                                  | :::                                                                                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Risk assessment                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              | Decontamination with activated charcoal as per aspirin if suitable                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                  | - Enhanced elimination: urinary alkalisation with administration of Sodium Bicarbonate . Haemodialysis for severe cases                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Supportive Care / Monitoring                                     |                                                                                                                                                                              | Antidote:                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Investigations                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                              | Administer N-Acetylcysteine if indicated as per nomogram or risk assessment.                                                                                                         |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Decontamination                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              | N-Acetylcysteine replenishes glutathione for NAPQI inactivation                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Enhanced elimination                                             |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Antidotes                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Disposition - Psychiatry involvement for deliberate overdoses    |                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                      |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Notes**                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                              | Survival from a paracetamol overdose is generally considered to be 100% in cases receiving NAC within 8 hours of exposure. Efficacy declines after this point                        |
